note: Opportunity cards and department assessments written by the AI departments (same model in different roles; NOT independent assurance). Scores 0-3 or null with basis.

target.user: solo freelancers who invoice clients without accounting software
target.scene: an invoice becomes overdue and a follow-up email must be written

value.problem_or_desire: writing and remembering awkward overdue-payment follow-ups
value.alternative: manual email; Stripe Invoicing built-in reminders (free per snippet); QuickBooks/FreshBooks/Wave reminders; Chaser/InvoiceSherpa
value.difference: tone-tested reminder sequence for people who do not use those systems (hypothesis)

why_now.observed: several 2026 founder posts and launches on the same idea
why_now.inferred: crowded; the change signal mostly reflects supply, not demand

build.minimum_offer: free web page that generates a 3-step polite reminder sequence for one overdue invoice (copy-paste, no account)
build.done_criteria: user generates and copies a sequence in under 2 minutes

delivery.access_basis: no verified channel access; community self-promotion rules unchecked

streams.note: would compete with free Stripe reminders

counterevidence.text: Stripe Invoicing sends automatic reminders by default (free) — strong substitute for Stripe users
most 'demand' evidence is founders validating their own products (interested parties), same origin type

target.scene: monthly: working out real profit after Etsy fees, ads, shipping and refunds

value.problem_or_desire: knowing true profit per item after all Etsy fees
value.alternative: paid spreadsheet templates on Etsy (~$15), free calculators, Link My Books/Craftybase
value.difference: import of the Etsy CSV that reconciles lump-sum deposits (hypothesis)

why_now.inferred: no change signal observed; evergreen need

build.minimum_offer: browser-only tool: upload Etsy monthly CSV, see fee breakdown and profit per listing (no data leaves the browser)
build.done_criteria: seller sees per-listing profit from a real CSV export

delivery.channel: Etsy seller forums + search 'etsy fee calculator'
delivery.access_basis: search results show many competing calculators; channel access unverified

counterevidence.text: free calculators and paid templates already exist; vendor claims of gaps come from competitors

opportunities.counterevidence_search_note: site:reddit.com search returned no seller threads (not evidence of absence)

target.user: viewers learning a specific AI/productivity tool
target.scene: searching how to do one task in a tool

value.alternative: official docs, thousands of existing tutorials

why_now.inferred: listicles claim tool tutorials work; written by vendors selling niche tools

build.minimum_offer: one screen-recorded tutorial on a narrow workflow
build.done_criteria: video answers one search query end-to-end

delivery.access_basis: no channel, no analytics, YouTube API not connected

counterevidence.text: only vendor listicles; no viewer demand data; YouTube limits repetitive/mass-produced content monetization

demand_value.basis: only founder posts and an aggregator citing one Reddit post; snippets

MARKETING.findings: Pain is plausible but evidence is from interested parties of one origin type; substitutes are free.

PRODUCT.findings: Trivial to build; differentiation is weak.

revenue_structure.basis: no price evidence; competing with free

unknowns: hosting cost if free tier changes
FINANCE.cost_view: build: owner time unknown; hosting: free tier assumed but unverified

SUPPORT.findings: Low support burden if no sending/accounts.

AUDIT.findings: All customer-voice items are snippets; two share one origin; counterevidence (free substitutes) is strong.

demand_value.basis: existence of paid templates suggests spend, sales unknown

MARKETING.findings: Spend signal exists; no direct customer voice captured.

AUDIT.findings: Rights/terms for using Etsy exports and branding unknown; customer voice missing.

revenue_structure.basis: monetization thresholds unmet; ad yield unknown

AUDIT.findings: Owner account and publish rights not granted; AI disclosure and monetization policy must be checked.

decision.rationale: No candidate is eligible: evidence is snippet-only, independent origins are few, and free substitutes contradict the strongest candidate. Selecting one would require inventing demand. Next batch must read full text and capture direct customer voice.
next_questions: Allow full-text domains (reddit.com, indiehackers.com, community forums) or connect Reddit/YouTube APIs, then re-run with the same run contract
For invoice reminders: how many target freelancers do NOT use Stripe/Wave/QuickBooks? (direct customer voice)
For Etsy fee tracker: confirm Etsy CSV/API terms and capture seller complaints in full text
